Prima & Timo — Album 5: Tria

Flora and Fauna

"Ancient life, never written down"

[Echoing footsteps in deep cave + distant water drips] [Verse 1] We gathered ourselves, hearts still heavy from the loss No time to grieve, we had to keep moving across The cave stretched downward, an ancient path laid long ago Kai suggested deeper — “Better than facing them, I know” We agreed and moved on, lights cutting through the black Deeper into the unknown, no turning back Then life appeared — strange, unfamiliar, alive Nothing Teemo had ever seen, nothing from any archive [Pre-Chorus] Preema’s upgrades hummed, identifying what she saw Species long extinct, from a time before human law [Chorus — wondrous] Flora and Fauna Ancient life, never written down Flora and Fauna Awakened deep beneath the ground They move and breathe in ways we’ve never known A world before us… quietly overgrown [Verse 2] Preema stopped suddenly, head tilted to the side One of the plants spoke — a frequency, a different kind No one else heard it, just her standing still It asked her softly, “Why are you here? How did you find this hill?” She answered in a pitch she didn’t know she could make Explaining the journey, the loss, the path they take The plant warned her gently, “Guardians wait below They are not friendly… be careful where you go” [Pre-Chorus 2] She thanked them quietly, the group staring in awe Wondering what she heard, what the plants saw [Chorus — wondrous] Flora and Fauna Ancient life, never written down Flora and Fauna Awakened deep beneath the ground They move and breathe in ways we’ve never known A world before us… quietly overgrown [Bridge — mysterious] Preema looked at them, screen glowing soft and true “I don’t know how I knew… but the upgrades feel new” Timo squeezed her hand, “We’ll figure it out together” As they continued deeper… into the unknown forever [Harp guitar solo]

[CODA] We continue to move continue to decend A different kind of adventure one with no end What will we find, who will we meet I guess we will see who is down there to greet

[key lift] [Chorus — wondrous] Flora and Fauna Ancient life, never written down Flora and Fauna Awakened deep beneath the ground They move and breathe in ways we’ve never known A world before us… quietly overgrown [Outro — tense wonder] The guardians are waiting… Somewhere down below. Bernard

[Spiral cave path ambience + gentle group sounds]

[Verse 1] We reached a spiral path that split in two Vendo kept dispensing snacks, trying to get it right for the crew Preema suggested rest, Kai scouted ahead for threats Toes toasted bread, Teemo found fruits, taking quiet breaths The environment was untouched, preserved through endless time Beauty in the silence, like a forgotten rhyme Then a voice boomed low, echoing through the stone “HO HO HO HO — WHO WHO WHO — GOES THERE ALONE?” [Pre-Chorus] We looked around, but saw no one in sight The voice was deep, ancient, but strangely light [Chorus — playful & wondrous] Bernard Small but voice so deep Bernard Colors changing as he leaps Pink then red, yellow, blue — a living light A tiny frog with a voice that fills the night [Verse 2] Still no one visible, the voice rang out again “I SAID HO HO HO — WHO GOES THERE, MY FRIEND?” Teemo felt a tug, looked down at his feet A small frog looking up, colors shifting, bright and sweet “I AM BERNARD — YOU UNDERSTAND MY TALK YES?” “I LEARN LANGUAGE FROM FRIEND BEFORE LONG TIME AGO, I GUESS” The crew was stunned, staring at the tiny colorful one Toes offered toast, Vendo a blue banana — just for fun [Pre-Chorus 2] He took both happily, munching with delight “VERY VERY NICE FOOD — I GO WITH YOU TONIGHT!” [Chorus — playful & wondrous] Bernard Small but voice so deep Bernard Colors changing as he leaps Pink then red, yellow, blue — a living light A tiny frog with a voice that fills the night [playful yukelele solo]

[CODA] It seems this crew has grown again here, underground A new friend, a new companion to show us around A mystical world awaits us deeper below So many things out there I need to know

[Bridge — warm] We smiled at each other, another strange friend found Bernard hopped beside us, colors shifting all around

[Pre-Chorus 2] Bernard sees me and smile like he understands YOU NO WORRY I VERY GOOD LIKE A NINJA [Chorus — playful & wondrous] Bernard Small but voice so deep Bernard Colors changing as he leaps Not sure how he knows about ninja’s and worries But this tiny frog is now part of our little broken family [Outro — hopeful] Bernard: “WE GO TOGETHER NOW — ADVENTURE AWAITS!”
